report:
Debezium Connector Commit Failure during large dataset

Hi everyone,
I’m facing an issue with a Debezium connector. While processing data, I saw this error:
Couldn't commit processed log positions with the source database due to a concurrent connector shutdown or restart.
[2025-01-17 11:10:06,134] INFO [cdc_connector_7e9474c6-391d-494b-afa2-263251f0b799|task-0|offsets] Couldn't commit processed log positions with the source database due to a concurrent connector shutdown or restart (io.debezium.connector.common.BaseSourceTask:473)
[2025-01-17 11:10:09,630] INFO 100.75.66.122 - - [17/Jan/2025:11:10:09 +0000] "GET /connectors HTTP/1.1" 200 584 "-" "kube-probe/1.29+" 0 (org.apache.kafka.connect.runtime.rest.RestServer:62)
[2025-01-17 11:10:09,631] INFO 100.75.66.122 - - [17/Jan/2025:11:10:09 +0000] "GET /connectors HTTP/1.1" 200 584 "-" "kube-probe/1.29+" 2 (org.apache.kafka.connect.runtime.rest.RestServer:62)
[2025-01-17 11:10:14,093] INFO [cdc_connector_7e9474c6-391d-494b-afa2-263251f0b799|task-0] 	 Exported 8667227 of 26177792 records for table 'aws.userlogin_access' after 00:10:18.699 (io.debezium.relational.RelationalSnapshotChangeEventSource:627)
This happened during a snapshot of a large table (~26M rows). Progress was being logged, but the connector failed to commit offsets. I’m worried this could cause duplicate events or data loss.
Setup
	•	Debezium on Kafka Connect (running in Kubernetes).
	•	Snapshotting a large dataset.
Questions
	1.	What could cause this “concurrent shutdown or restart” issue?
	2.	How can I ensure reliable offset commits?
	3.	Any tips for handling large snapshots?
Any advice would be greatly appreciated!
Thanks,
Nikhil Channa

evidence.quote: This is expected during a long running snapshot and it's normal and nothing to worry about.

notes: The 'Couldn't commit processed log positions' INFO log looks like a failure; it is expected while a snapshot runs. BaseSourceTask commit logic settles it.
